_about: Worksheet Generators (docs/WORKSHEETS-PLAN.md, Generators): each one is site/assets/gen/<id>.js and makes a new sheet with its answer key every time. Pages live at /closet/worksheets/make/<id>/. Check with: node scripts/check_generators.mjs
groups: Number, fractions, equations, shapes and word problems. Every answer is worked out by the generator.
Calculations and genetics with the steps shown on the key.
Vocabulary and puzzles built from the Word Wall, plus map skills and timelines.
Organizers, writing frames, planners, logs and reflections for any topic you type in.

generators.title: Number Operations
generators.blurb: Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division, from facts within 10 to long division, with or without regrouping.

generators.title: Fractions
generators.blurb: Equivalent fractions, comparing, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing, with fraction pictures for the younger grades.

generators.title: Expressions and Equations
generators.blurb: Evaluate expressions, then solve one-step, two-step and both-sides equations and inequalities. The key shows each step.

generators.title: Area, Perimeter and Volume
generators.blurb: Drawn shapes with their measurements: rectangles, triangles, circles, composite shapes, boxes and cylinders.

generators.title: Coordinate Plane
generators.blurb: A drawn coordinate plane with lettered points: plot and name points, find distances, reflect across an axis, draw shapes and find their sides, then translate, rotate and dilate figures.

generators.title: Word Problems
generators.blurb: Everyday stories about money, time, measurement and sharing, plus fractions, rates and percents for older grades, with room to show the work.

generators.title: Science Calculations
generators.blurb: Density, speed, acceleration, weight, work and power, then force from grade 8 and Ohm's law, momentum and kinetic energy in high school, with the formula, units and the worked answer.

generators.title: Punnett Squares
generators.blurb: One-trait and two-trait crosses with real traits: fill the square, then give the genotype and phenotype ratios.

generators.title: Reading Graphs
generators.blurb: A picture graph, bar graph, line graph or table with questions that go from reading a value to comparing and finding the mean.

generators.title: Vocabulary Practice
generators.blurb: Pick any module on the Word Wall: match words to meanings, then fill in the missing word.

generators.title: Word Puzzles
generators.blurb: A word search or crossword made from any module's Word Wall words, with the meanings as clues.

generators.title: Map Skills
generators.blurb: A made-up town on a grid with a compass rose, a key and a scale: find places, give directions and measure distances.

generators.title: Timelines
generators.blurb: Put real events in order on a timeline, from inventions to U.S. and world history, then count the years between them.

generators.title: Graphic Organizer Maker
generators.blurb: Type your topic and pick a layout: compare, cause and effect, main idea, sequence, claim and evidence, and more.

generators.title: Writing Frames
generators.blurb: Opinion, informative, narrative, science claim-evidence-reasoning, compare and summary frames, built for the grade, with fresh starters and a standards checklist.

generators.title: Planners, Logs and Reflections
generators.blurb: Project planners, reading, practice and science logs, weekly and exit reflections, and goal setting (SMART from grade 6), sized for the grade.
